stance_rationale: Primary alpha artifact and walk-forward claims fail independent verification: alpha_scores.parquet is a 348-row single snapshot with no Date/sig_date column, while the 219-date reconstruction uses ex-post fixed theta from full-sample IC. Rank IC, DSR, monotonicity, RF-A2, RF-A6, RF-A7, lineage, and covariance condition checks also fail.

harvey_t.reason: Reported statistic is computed as mean/(sd/sqrt(n)); Newey-West HAC and 5-spec regression evidence were not found.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260501_001/alpha_scores.parquet has only Ticker, alpha, alpha_z, confidence. composite_alpha_panel.parquet has 219 dates, but it is not the package signal_matrix_ref and uses fixed full-sample theta from alpha_package.

RF-A2.evidence: Composite ICIR=0.2913 is below best single factor D43_Skewness ICIR=0.2956.

RF-A3.evidence: Recent 3Y ICIR=0.4228 vs full 0.2913, ratio=1.45 below 1.5 threshold but close.

RF-A5.evidence: Universe filter targets 20d TV >= 2e8 KRW, but PIT-C10 failure leaves this only conditionally verified.

RF-A6.evidence: 9 specs screened, no valid DSR, no 5-spec simultaneous regressions, and reported Harvey t is naive.

RF-A7.evidence: Mandated alpha_scores.parquet is single snapshot with no date dimension.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Factor selection and theta are computed from the full 2008-2026 IC panel, then reused across all historical schedule dates.
Universe DV20 filter uses rd[Date <= sig_date], so signal-date volume can enter the liquidity screen.
Retail_Net_Z is manually sign-flipped, and posterior_IC sign is applied again as theta despite Z_Score_Aligned convention.
Factor DB connector filters IC history by Usable_Date <= sig_date; investor flow uses <= sig_date-1, though raw publication lag is not separately encoded.
Existing DB factors use load_month_factors(), but Retail_Net_Z directly reads investor_wide.parquet and is not loaded through Factor DB.
No regime/overlay alpha component was applied.

critical_concerns.description: The 219-date backtest uses fixed factor selection and theta estimated from the full 2008-2026 IC history, so historical weights inherit future IC information.
The mandated alpha_scores.parquet is not Date x Ticker x score; it has 348 tickers and no time dimension, directly triggering the Iter 4 single-snapshot failure mode.
Retail_Net_Z is explicitly sign-flipped and then receives negative theta; this contradicts Z_Score_Aligned-only discipline and leaves the retail-flow economic direction ambiguous.
rank_ic=0.0363 fails the 0.04 gate, DSR=0 fails the 0.50 gate, monotonicity=0.222 fails the 0.80 gate, yet the package recommends proceeding based on ICIR and a claimed DSR format issue.
Composite ICIR=0.2913 is below D43_Skewness ICIR=0.2956, so the six-factor blend has not demonstrated incremental alpha after complexity is added.
The final optimizer implementation is long-only top-20 Top_EW, which is the mechanism-break pattern AX-007 warns about; none of the four AX-007 exceptions is satisfied.
The 20d trading-value universe screen uses signal-date data, so the RF-A5 liquidity pass is not PIT-clean until rebuilt with t-1 liquidity only.
covariance.parquet is PSD, but recomputed condition number is about 224.9 and risk_package reports 206.53, both above the requested post-shrink limit of 100.

No challenge_note file exists, qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260501_001 is absent, the requested mailbox weights.csv is absent, and artifact_lineage alpha hashes do not match the current alpha_package hash.

supporting_arguments: composite_alpha_panel.parquet does contain 219 dates from 2008-01-31 to 2026-03-31, and stage_artifacts weights.csv has 219 monthly schedules with 20 names, sum weight=1, long-only, and 5% per name.
Existing DB factors are accessed through load_month_factors(), and the connector code contains Usable_Date <= sig_date logic.
ICIR=0.2913 and subperiod_stability=1.0 are real positives, but they are not enough to override rank IC, DSR, monotonicity, RF-A2, RF-A6, and RF-A7 failures.
covariance.parquet is positive definite with min eigenvalue about 0.00384, but the condition-number mandate is still missed.
